data.rationale: The proposal follows the true flow in the right order (Flights tab, trip type, origin and destination, date, passengers, Search, sort Fastest, See flight, Select, Next) and names the main parameters, but it adds an optional direct-flights filter and a ticket-type choice, and it leaves out second_leg for multi-city.
